Clerk vs Firebase Auth / Identity Platform

Answer: As of 2026-11-07: Clerk and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform tie at $0 for 1k users · no SSO; Firebase Auth / Identity Platform wins 10k users · 1 SSO at $2.25/mo ($1,473/yr less than Clerk) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection: Clerk Pro $125/mo includes $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on) [Firebase Auth / Identity Platform SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection: Clerk $125/mo, Firebase Auth / Identity Platform $29.25/mo]; Firebase Auth / Identity Platform wins 50k users · 5 SSO at $14.25/mo ($4,929/yr less than Clerk) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection: Clerk Pro $425/mo includes $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on) [Firebase Auth / Identity Platform SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection: Clerk $425/mo, Firebase Auth / Identity Platform $149.25/mo]; Firebase Auth / Identity Platform wins 100k users · 10 SSO at $304.25/mo ($17,949/yr less than Clerk) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection: Clerk Pro $1,800/mo includes $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on) [Firebase Auth / Identity Platform SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection: Clerk $1,800/mo, Firebase Auth / Identity Platform $574.25/mo].

Also need SCIM? At 10k users · 3 SSO + 3 SCIM customers (assumes every SCIM customer is also an SSO customer; assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection): Clerk Pro $425/mo incl. $150/mo SCIM (Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01, $0 before) and $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on; Firebase Auth / Identity Platform: no SCIM price (no SCIM on the pricing page). How each vendor bills SCIM.

Cheapest verified plan per vendor, monthly USD list price. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. All org terms · set your org count. How we calculate this.

Clerk

Hobby free to 50k MRU/app. Pro $25/mo ($20 annual) with 50k MRU + 1 SSO + 1 Directory Sync. Extra SSO $75 (2–15) then $60 (16–100) and $48 (101–250). Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01.

Source: clerk.com/pricing · 2026-11-07

Firebase Auth / Identity Platform

No cost up to 50k MAU (email, phone, anonymous, social), then $0.0055/MAU to 100k, $0.0046 to 1M, $0.0032 to 10M, $0.0025 above. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. SMS (phone sign-in and MFA) billed per message by region (US $0.01); first 10 SMS a day not billed. Sources: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing.

Source: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing · 2026-11-07
